events.text: In 2022, PLDT and Smart announced their decarbonization plan, which aims to cut down their Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 40% by 2030.
In 2024, PLDT completed a corporate carbon footprint assessment and publicly disclosed its GHG emissions according to the GHG Protocol, covering Scope 1, 2 and 3.
PLDT secured its first P1-B green loan from HSBC.
Metrobank approved PLDT's P4-B green loan, PLDT's second green loan and its first from a local financial institution.
PLDT's total green debt hit P5 billion after securing a P4-billion green loan from Metrobank.

On February 14, 2024, the Supreme Court of the Philippines issued a decision in G.R. Nos. 244695, 244752 & 245294, Manggagawa sa Komunikasyon ng Pilipinas vs. PLDT, Inc., involving labor-related petitions.
PLDT Group's decarbonization roadmap aims to reduce its Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions by 40 percent by 2030, from a 2019 baseline.

Metrobank approved PLDT's P4 billion green loan, PLDT's first green loan from a local financial institution and its second green loan following the P1 billion secured from HSBC Philippines last March.
PLDT announced through a disclosure to the local bourse that it secured a P4-billion green loan from Metrobank, bringing its total green debt to P5 billion.
The Supreme Court backs the ruling of Court of Appeals to regularize employees of PLDT engaged in installation, repair, and maintenance services.
